task_definition.task_description: Please scan the living room for smart devices, then check what devices are connected there and look up the status of the living room light. After that, turn that light on to 65% brightness with a warm white color, get the current time in New York, and then send me an in-app medium-priority alert for Alice documenting that it was executed.
